name: pwa-install-prompt
title: PWA install prompt
description: A prompt to install your web app: a real Install button where the browser supports it, and share-sheet steps on iPhone.
docs: It listens for beforeinstallprompt and shows Install with Not now; on iOS Safari, which has no such event, it shows the Share, then Add to Home Screen steps after delay ms. It is hidden when the app already runs standalone, a dismissal is remembered in localStorage for dismissDays (14), and it never appears on first paint. platform="ios" forces the steps for a preview. The root is a window-sized, click-through box that the card measures itself against: a bottom sheet below 36rem and a corner card above, with safe-area padding; pass className="absolute" to place it inside a box of your own. Mount it once, high in the app, so it is listening before the browser fires its event. icon is an element for the app tile; onInstalled and onDismiss are callbacks.
